jei.robotica.info.servo_core: Dropped by the Scrap Colossus: use a Signal Flare on a Colossus Altar (in Rusted Foundry ruins, or crafted). Opens the Servo Age: the parts and machines that need a Servo Core are built from it. A pricier fallback recipe exists for Peaceful worlds.
jei.robotica.info.magma_core: Dropped by Robotica bosses. Put it in the Replicator's catalyst slot to copy blazes, endermen, guardians, ghasts and other tier 3 mobs, or in a Survey Rig's core slot to take ancient debris. It is never used up.
jei.robotica.info.antigrav_core: Dropped by Robotica bosses. Put it in the Replicator's catalyst slot to copy shulkers. It is never used up and opens the Antigrav Age parts.
jei.robotica.info.essence_vial: Right-click a hostile mob to take a sample (2 damage, 3 second cooldown). The first sample binds the vial to that mob type. Eight samples fill it. Put the full vial in a Replicator. Bosses cannot be sampled.
jei.robotica.info.mainspring: A battery you wind by hand. Put it in a Winding Crank and hold right-click with an empty hand to wind it, or feed the crank with FE. It fills in about 20 seconds. Mainsprings only charge in the crank, and can then power a robot or machine from its battery slot.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.speed: Makes the machine work faster, for more energy per action.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.range: Gives a bigger work area. Robots get +2 radius per card, the Excavator 16, 32, 48 or 64 blocks.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.efficiency: Uses less energy per action: -15% per card, never below 40% of the base cost.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.fortune: Fortune I to III on mined blocks, one level per card. In the Replicator it gives Looting. Cannot be combined with a Silk Touch card.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.silk: Mined blocks drop themselves. Cannot be combined with a Fortune card.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.growth: +50% crop and sapling growth per card.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.void: Deletes cobblestone, dirt, gravel and other junk instead of storing it.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.stackable: Cards of this kind stack in one upgrade slot: each card adds one step, up to %s. The machine says how many it takes.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.single: Only one card of this kind fits in a machine.
jei.robotica.info.upgrade.rules: Right-click a machine or robot with the card, or put it in an upgrade slot. Machines only take the kinds they have a use for.
